understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level while avoiding spike tiles. Levels must be completed within the available attempts and turn limit.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, after which gravity automatically carries the player until landing or encountering an obstacle, hazard, or goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y-values. CLICK removes a clickable breakable tile at the specified coordinates without moving the player, and UNDO reverts the previous action. Landing on spikes ends the attempt, while safe support tiles allow continued movement. Fall-destination previews and corridor scans indicate which horizontal moves lead to useful passages.
